item.description: The husband of a U.S. Homeland Security police officer is facing charges after investigators say he used his spouse's police vehicle while she was away to pose as an officer. item.title: Philadelphia honors fallen officer Andy Chan at annual block party
item.description: A community gathered in Fishtown for the 6th Annual Andy Chan Block Party, honoring the legacy of a fallen Philadelphia police officer. A night of remembrance and support The event was organized by Families Behind the Badge Children's Foundation. It raised funds for families of fallen and injured law enforcement officers, including Officer Andy Chan's family.
